title: Cyrus and the Letter
author: Emrys Sandoval
blurb: Edmund Sterling, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
